levels.surface: عامر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: The last link is «عن أبيه»; the story names the father later as «سعدا» (the one Mu'awiya addresses) and that name is not written into the chain. The father's own words («سمعت رسول الله يقول») are the saying.
«وتقاربا في اللفظ» and «وهو ابن إسماعيل» are a wording note and a gloss, left out.
